New grants support community archives across the region

March 12, 2025

Share this page

The Regional Heritage Council today announced twenty-four new grants for community archives, local history societies and small museums. The awards range from two thousand to fifteen thousand pounds and will fund cataloguing, digitisation and volunteer training over the next two years.

Applications came from every district in the region, and the panel gave priority to projects that open collections to the public for the first time. Several of the funded archives hold parish records, photographs and oral histories that have never been catalogued.

The chair of the council said that local archives keep the memory of places that national institutions rarely reach. She thanked the volunteers who prepared the applications and encouraged other groups to apply in the autumn round.

The full list of recipients is published on the funding pages of this website.
